column1: # GSP firmware for NVIDIA's open kernel modules (ANAL-297), from NVIDIA's own 615.78.08 driver package: the same release
# as kernel/patches/nvidia-open/PIN (nvidia.ko asks for nvidia/<its version>/<file>). scripts/kernel-nvidia-open-firmware.py
# stages these unmodified as /vendor/firmware/<install path>. Not in linux-firmware, whose NVIDIA files are nouveau's.
# GB20x (GB205: the G14's RTX 5070 Ti Laptop) loads gsp_ga10x.bin and ucodes_ga10x.bin (kernel-open/common/inc/nv-firmware.h:
# every family from GA10x on maps to the *_ga10x files; gsp_log_* only with firmware logging, which is off).
# Licence: the NVIDIA Driver License Agreement in the package (LICENSE), §1.1(c) own use, §1.1(d) distribution with
# OSI-licensed kernels, unmodified, with the Agreement; §2.1 NVIDIA hardware only. docs/nvidia-open-ruby.md §6.
